subtitle: AI-First Clinical Companion
shortDescription: AI-powered ward rounds, SOAP dictation, escalations & patient care — built for clinicians.
fullDescription:
Umoya Clinical is a world-class, AI-first electronic health record companion designed for doctors, nurses, and patients in modern healthcare facilities.

FOR DOCTORS:
• Smart ward rounds with AI patient summaries, SLA timers, and vital trend sparklines
• Voice dictation → AI-drafted SOAP notes awaiting your signature
• CDSS tools: drug interactions, dose calculator, WHO guidelines, diagnosis suggestions
• Real-time escalation inbox with live SLA countdown timers
• HIPAA-secure messaging with colleagues and patients

FOR NURSES:
• Shift worklist with AI copilot task prioritisation
• Triage dashboard with ESI scoring assistance
• Live vitals entry with instant AI interpretation and escalation
• Quick-reply secure messaging

FOR PATIENTS:
• Plain-language visit summary: understand your diagnosis and treatment plan
• Ask AI about any part of your care — citation-grounded answers
• Medication adherence tracker with 7-day history
• Bill management with EcoCash, OneMoney, card, and bank transfer payment
• Connected health devices: Apple Health, Fitbit, Google Fit, Samsung Health, Garmin, Withings
• Medical records vault: view, share, and ask AI about your documents

SECURITY & COMPLIANCE:
• HIPAA end-to-end encrypted messaging
• All sessions audit-logged
• Screen privacy overlay prevents OS screenshots of patient data
• Automatic session lock after 5 minutes of inactivity
• Biometric authentication (Face ID / Fingerprint)

releaseNotes.en-US: Initial release of Umoya Clinical — AI-first ward rounds, voice SOAP dictation, real-time escalation inbox, nurse shift management, and the full patient companion suite including medication tracking, bills, and health records.
